Dear ,

Before I write anything else, please read this with a smile, because every word here comes straight from my heart.

Once upon a time… ✨

Even before I knew you, the universe was quietly writing our story.

Happy Birthday, ! 🎂🎉

Today is your special day, and I wanted my words to be the first gift you open. The world became a little more beautiful the day you were born.

Tap the candles, close your eyes, and make a wish… 🕯️

May this year bring you endless smiles, every dream you have quietly carried, good health, peace in your heart, and a love that never lets you feel alone. You deserve every good thing in this world, and I will always pray for your happiness.

Happy Birthday, my love. May all your wishes come true. 🎁

In school, we met 🎒

We were friends, two people in the same school. I had no idea that a simple hello would become the most beautiful part of my life.

The day it all began 🌸

At the end of school, it began 💗

Near the end of our school days, something quietly changed. My friendship with you turned into love. I kept it in my heart, and every day it grew.

"I never said it out loud, but my heart said your name every single day."

In college, we met again 🌼

Life brought us together again, as if it knew. The love I started feeling in school was still there, waiting for you.

Still the same magic 💫

And now, today 💍

You are the smile I look for first, the peace I go home to, and the one person my heart keeps choosing, again and again.

My favourite view 🤍

I don't need a perfect day. I only need every day with you.

My promises to you 🤞💍

Words are easy, so here are the things I truly promise, and I will spend my life keeping every one of them:

  • I promise to always be your best friend first, just like the day we met.
  • I promise to respect you, listen to you, and never let you feel alone.
  • I promise to hold your hand in your happiest days and hold it tighter in your hardest ones.
  • I promise to be honest with you, even when it is difficult.
  • I promise to support your dreams and cheer for you louder than anyone.
  • I promise to wipe your tears and to be the reason you laugh.
  • I promise to choose you every morning, every argument, every ordinary day.
  • I promise to love you the same in old age as I do today.
  • I promise to make you feel like the most special girl in the world, always.

"You are my today, my tomorrow, and all my forever."

Why I love you 💞

I love the way you smile without knowing how beautiful it is. I love how kind your heart is, and how calm the world feels when you are near. I love the girl from school, the girl from college, and the woman you are today. Every version of you is the one I fall for.

What my heart wants to say 🌹

Some feelings are too big for a simple "I love you," but let me try anyway.

With you, silence feels comfortable, ordinary days feel special, and even the hardest moments feel lighter. When I think about my future, I do not picture a grand place or a perfect life. I picture you beside me, laughing at something small, and me thinking how lucky I am.

If I could give you one gift, it would be the ability to see yourself through my eyes. Then you would know why my heart has never looked anywhere else.

"You are not just the one I love. You are the one I want to grow old with."

If I could 💫

  • If I could stop time, I would stop it on the days I spent with you.
  • If I could choose again, I would still choose you, a thousand times over.
  • If I could give you the moon, I would, but I would rather give you my whole life.
  • If I could write your name across the sky, every star would spell "Atchaya".
  • If I had to wait a lifetime for you, I would, and it would still be worth it.

And now, with my whole heart in my hands…

Atchaya, will you be mine?

Forever yours,

Thank you,

You have made me the happiest person in the world.

From a simple hello in school to this very moment, every step was leading me to you.

I promise to love you today, tomorrow, and for every day that follows.

Happy Birthday, my love.

Forever yours,
